SHARETHELOAD.NonPlayerCarrier: Not a player character — carrying via player ownership
SHARETHELOAD.Hint.Pile: Each loot actor keeps its own independent carrier list, so a character may carry shares from several piles at once.
SHARETHELOAD.Hint.Carriers: Listed are this loot actor's group members first, then any actor a player owns. To let an NPC such as a mule or hireling share the load, give the players ownership of it. Checked carriers have this pile's weight counted against their carrying capacity; the items never leave the loot actor.
SHARETHELOAD.Hint.Manual: Sliders always total 100%. Moving one redistributes the remainder across the others, keeping their proportions to each other.
SHARETHELOAD.Hint.CurrencyRuleOff: The dnd5e "Apply Currency Weight" rule is off, so coin weight is ignored regardless of this setting.
SHARETHELOAD.Notify.Cleared: Removed this pile's shared load effects.
SHARETHELOAD.NoPiles: No group actors found. Create a group actor to use as a party loot pile.
SHARETHELOAD.NoCarriers: No eligible carriers. Add members to this group actor, or give a player ownership of an actor.
SHARETHELOAD.EffectDescription: Carrying a {weight} share of the load from {pile}.
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.AutoSync.Name: Recalculate Automatically
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.AutoSync.Hint: Update carried shares whenever a configured loot actor's contents change. Turn off to apply only manually.
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Menu.Name: Carrier Configuration
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Menu.Hint: Choose which characters share the weight of each party loot actor.
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Menu.Label: Configure Carriers
